description: Ionic provides web components styled for app screens. With React, you can build pages, lists and forms that work in a browser and can be packaged for devices. Start with the browser version and simple local state. Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.
versionNote: Uses Ionic React core components and controlled overlay APIs.
